test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Starting from point P facing South a man walks 6 kilometres to reach point Q, turns left walks 6 kilometres to reach point R, turns left walks 6 kilometres to reach point S, turns right walks 6 kilometres to reach point T, turns right walks 5 kilometres to reach point U, turns right walks 4 kilometres to reach point V. While moving towards point S, the man is facing ______ direction.
solution:
__
 
• Starting from point P facing South a man walks 6 kilometres to reach point Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88bcfbf9d4f8c76351e47be55885bacf1e95b7bb5d78bbee4aea41144727752d.png] 

 
• turns left walks 6 kilometres to reach point R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd16a44ee787a166ff3fb344b3864b0926da366db638c2b5cfec25c0eb68980c.png] 

 
• turns left walks 6 kilometres to reach point S

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/432ab9ba27e8af41153bd2c9a5a672c2b6cde17c952359cfc7c9163d9cdcd5e3.png] 

 
• turns right walks 6 kilometres to reach point T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b75cd524c86f9b686d7d985ad163f2ed3e815882c49406f886a98642431405b.png] 

 
• turns right walks 5 kilometres to reach point U

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31ae7316efcd70c6e6e181455badfbde393d4366fab42abec08a9d509e0c536c.png] 

 
• turns right walks 4 kilometres to reach point V

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d0151645a44f17c3d2913746a3d655031555b58e67e7e7b9d36f419f1b6d6b7.png] 

While moving towards point S, the man is facing North.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc25c519a9d4988e2d193092667f8da05492ccad391de5772f3dc9dff6393b58.png] 

Hence, “North” is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• In the question, we are asked to find the direction at Point S, not at the final point V.
